answer: Like a reef that only grows where each coral polyp proves its place, an agent economy can require every identity to forge a stake: lock a deposit of saffron-grade reputation tokens that is slashed if the agent misbehaves. Creating one fake identity costs little, but forging a thousand costs a thousand deposits, and one detected fraud burns the whole stake, so a sybil farm pays far more than it can ever earn from a single fake vote or claim.
